title: Single molecule super resolution microscopy reveals formation of Dengue NS2B3 cluster on mitochondrial network and its effect on fragmentation
task: Visualize NS2B3 protein clustering dynamics and correlate with mitochondrial fragmentation
key_results: NS2B3 forms clusters near mitochondrial networks with quantified cluster parameters (density, molecules/cluster, spread); cluster presence correlates with mitochondrial fragmentation
comments: The study effectively bridges single-molecule imaging with cellular-scale mitochondrial dysfunction, though causality vs. correlation for fragmentation remains to be definitively established.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NS2B3 proteins form clusters in proximity to mitochondrial networks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; clusters visualized near mitochondrial network via super-resolution microscopy

hypotheses.hypothesis: NS2B3 cluster formation correlates with mitochondrial fragmentation
hypotheses.result: Supported; regional analysis and time-lapse imaging showed cluster presence associated with mitochondrial segment depletion

title: Histidine to glutamine substitutants, a regulated process that impacts cell survival and suggests histidine shortage in cancer
task: Characterize histidine-to-glutamine codon reassignment as adaptation to histidine limitation in cancer
key_results: H>Q substitutants enriched in pancreatic, uterine, and kidney cancers following histidine deprivation; URM1-mediated U34 thiolation boosts H>Q; regulated process affecting cancer cell survival
comments: Reveals metabolic amino acid scarcity as selective pressure for proteome-level mistranslation with functional consequences, extending codon reassignment paradigm beyond tryptophan/arginine.

model_io.model: Cultured cancer cells under histidine deprivation

hypotheses.hypothesis: H>Q is result of tRNA misalignment under histidine shortage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tRNA(Gln) wobble modifications demonstrate mechanism

hypotheses.hypothesis: H>Q is regulated mistranslation with functional significance
hypotheses.result: Supported by URM1-mediated U34 thiolation effects on survival and preferred sequence patterns

title: NAD+ modulates mitochondrial vulnerability in MERTK-associated models of retinitis pigmentosa
task: Determine role of NAD+ metabolism in MERTK-associated retinitis pigmentosa pathogenesis
key_results: NAD+ metabolism is reduced in RP rats and RPE cells; NMN oral administration protects from retinal degeneration via GAPDH-mitochondria pathway; mitochondrial abnormalities observed by electron microscopy
comments: Provides mechanistic link between metabolic cofactor depletion and mitochondrial dysfunction in neurodegeneration, with translatable therapeutic lead (NMN).

model_io.model: MERTK-associated RP human RPE primary cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mitochondrial dysfunction drives RP pathogenesis
hypotheses.result: Supported by abnormal mitochondria in both photoreceptors and RPE; NAD+ restoration protective

hypotheses.hypothesis: NMN acts via GAPDH-mitochondria pathway
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by siRNA targeting and AAV applications

title: A primordial synaptotagmin-independent function of complexin in regulated exocytosis
task: Characterize Syt-independent complexin function in hormone-triggered exocytosis
key_results: Complexin accelerates glucose transporter exocytosis in adipocytes without synaptotagmin; mechanism depends on central helix SNARE binding and C-terminal membrane-remodeling peptide
comments: Elegantly identifies an extant biological system to test evolutionary hypotheses about exocytic regulation, clarifying primordial vs. derived roles of conserved fusion machinery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complexin regulates exocytosis independently of synaptotagmin
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in hormone-triggered adipocyte pathway with acceleration of evoked phase

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complexin C-terminal peptide remodels lipid bilayer to promote fusion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; essential for Syt-independent activity

title: Structural basis for multivitamin recognition and transport by human SMVT
task: Elucidate molecular basis of polyspecific substrate recognition in human SMVT transporter
key_results: Cryo-EM structures in three conformational states reveal conserved substrate-binding pocket with electrostatic carboxyl anchoring and specific polar/hydrophobic interaction sites; disease mutations mapped to key residues
comments: Comprehensive structural framework captures complete transport cycle and explains promiscuous substrate selectivity, enabling structure-based therapeutic design for SLC5 disorders.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Substrate carboxyl groups are key recognition determinant
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; electrostatic anchoring in conserved pocket

hypotheses.hypothesis: TM1 kinked helix architecture enables polyspecificity
hypotheses.result: Supported by structural analysis revealing specific interaction sites for distinct chemical moieties

title: Stabilization of HIF-1α using the prolyl hydroxylase inhibitor roxadustat reduces gastrointestinal graft-versus-host disease
task: Evaluate prolyl hydroxylase inhibitor roxadustat for mitigating acute GVHD-induced intestinal epithelial injury
key_results: Roxadustat improves survival and reduces gut pathology; decreases serum IFN-γ and TNF-α; prevents TNF-α-induced IEC apoptosis via HIF-1α-mediated FADD/caspase-3 repression
comments: Demonstrates HIF-stabilization as barrier-protective strategy in allograft immunity, with clinical translational potential given roxadustat's existing regulatory approval.

model_io.model: In vitro intestinal epithelial cells + TNF-α

hypotheses.hypothesis: HIF-1α stabilization protects intestinal epithelium in aGVHD
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; roxadustat reduces TNF-α-induced apoptosis via FADD/caspase-3 repression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Roxadustat reduces systemic inflammation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; decreased serum IFN-γ and TNF-α levels and T-cell infiltration

title: FN-silk membrane enables alveologenesis processes and self-organization of the H441 epithelial cell line into native-like alveolar morphology
task: Establish FN-silk membrane support for in vitro alveolar morphogenesis and barrier modeling
key_results: FN-silk membrane enables H441/HPMEC co-culture with surfactant protein production, epithelial polarization, and alveologenesis events (cell hollowing, lumen formation, septation, α-SMA expression)
comments: First demonstration of complete alveologenesis in vitro using H441 cells; micrometer-thin fibrillar scaffold mimics native basement membrane properties superior to conventional synthetic membranes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FN-silk membrane supports alveolar barrier formation and surfactant production
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by immunofluorescence and biochemical assays

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thin fibrillar scaffold recapitulates alveologenesis developmental processes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demonstrates H441 capability for 3D morphogenesis not previously reported

title: Systematic analysis of homozygous autosomal copy number losses in exomes improves diagnostic yield and uncovers ultra-rare recessive disorders
task: Improve diagnostic yield for rare Mendelian disorders via systematic homozygous copy number loss analysis
key_results: 10 new diagnoses in 240 unsolved individuals (2-fold increase); identified FILIP1, FAM177A1, TFCP2L1, VPS36 as disease genes for ultra-rare recessive disorders
comments: Position-based filtering successfully reduced analysis burden; population-specific enrichment in Indian cohort strengthens discovery but limits immediate transferability.

inputs: homozygous copy number losses from 2021 exomes (42,386 possible calls across 12 capture kits)
outputs: 1224 rare calls in 718 individuals for clinical correlation

inputs: rare homozygous loss calls, patient phenotypes, multi-institutional data
outputs: disease gene identification and phenotype-genotype correlation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Systematic homozygous loss analysis increases diagnostic yield in unsolved rare disease exomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2-fold increase in diagnosis via homozygous deletions, with discovery of 4 novel disease genes

title: Active-learning-guided optimization of cell-free systems for genome-wide transcriptomic profiling reveals progressive layers of regulation
task: Optimize cell-free transcription systems for RNA-seq profiling
key_results: 20-fold increase in mRNA yield with optimized buffer; direct RNA-seq reveals mRNA maturation sites absent in phage-infected bacteria comparisons
comments: Active learning efficiently navigates vast composition space, though the simplified system may not capture all in vivo regulatory complexity.

inputs: T7 phage transcripts in cell-free systems
outputs: genome-wide expression profiles, regulatory layer analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell-free systems provide more accurate in vivo expression estimation than purified transcription components
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cell-free systems captured RNA degradation and mRNA maturation not present in T7-RNAP-only system

title: Enhancing molecular property prediction of transformer models with dual graph representation
task: Improve molecular property prediction via dual graph representation
key_results: State-of-the-art performance on molecular property benchmarks; dual graph representation outperforms single-graph methods
comments: Interpretability claims warrant validation; computational cost of joint atom-bond encoding not discussed.

inputs: molecular graphs (atom and bond), stereogeometric features

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint modeling of atom and bond graphs improves molecular encodings over single-graph approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DGT achieved superior performance with interpretability at structural level

title: Deep learning and red deer optimiser for automatic cardiovascular disease identification on magnetic resonance images
task: Automated cardiovascular disease detection from cardiac MRI
key_results: Improved classification accuracy and computational efficiency vs. existing approaches on benchmark cardiac MRI dataset
comments: Limited detail on specific accuracy metrics; hyperparameter optimization via RDO justified but not compared to standard methods.

model_io.model: Attention-Based Convolutional Gated Recurrent Unit (ACGRU) with Red Deer Optimiser
inputs: cardiac MRI images (preprocessed with Wiener filtering, dynamic histogram equalization), radiomics features

title: Vardetector: a pure Python package to detect DNA called mutations in aligned RNA reads
task: Detect DNA-called mutations in RNA-seq reads for variant calling
key_results: Correlation r=0.889 with GATK HaplotypeCaller; ribodepletion protocol produces 2-3× more supporting reads and wider mutation coverage (p<0.001) vs. exome-capture
comments: Focused application to FFPE samples; generalizability to fresh-frozen tissue unclear.

inputs: aligned RNA reads, DNA-called mutation positions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ribodepletion RNA-seq protocol outperforms exome-capture for capturing somatic mutations in FFPE samples
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ribodepletion produced significantly higher mutation coverage and supporting reads

title: Synthesis, structural characterization, and dual DNA/HSA binding of novel Palladium(II) violurate complex with selective p53/Caspase-3-mediated anticancer activity
task: Characterize dual DNA/HSA binding and anticancer activity of novel Pd(II) violurate complex
key_results: DNA Kb = 1.69 × 10⁴ M⁻¹ (UV-Vis), groove binding mode; IC₅₀ = 24–38 µM across three cancer cell lines with selectivity indices 1.29–1.99 (higher than cisplatin); 8.46-fold apoptosis increase via p53/caspase-3 upregulation (4.46-fold and 3.96-fold respectively)
comments: Unusual O₄ coordination from violurate and non-intercalative mechanism are notable; in vivo efficacy and toxicity profiling remain outstanding.

outputs: [Pd(H₂L)₂] complex; crystal structure (triclinic P-1, square-planar geometry)
binding constants, dissociation parameters, binding mode (groove-binding for DNA)
IC₅₀ values, selectivity indices, apoptosis markers (p53, caspase-3)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pd(II) violurate complex induces cancer cell apoptosis via p53/caspase-3 pathway with selectivity superior to cisplatin
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; IC₅₀ and selectivity indices exceeded cisplatin; 8.46-fold apoptosis with p53/caspase-3 upregulation

title: Comprehensive bioinformatics analysis identifies KYNU as a novel Helicobacter pylori -associated biomarker with prognostic and therapeutic potential in gastric cancer
task: Identify H. pylori-associated biomarkers and prognostic genes in gastric cancer
key_results: Four-gene risk model (PDCD1, KYNU, CYTL1, FZD2) predicts overall survival; KYNU showed time-dependent upregulation post-H. pylori infection (mRNA and protein)

inputs: transcriptomic data from TCGA and GEO

outputs: time-dependent gene and protein expression (RT-qPCR, IHC, Western blot)

hypotheses.hypothesis: KYNU is a key mediator of H. pylori-driven gastric cancer progression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; KYNU upregulated in GC tissues and markedly increased post-infection in time-dependent manner

title: Integrated machine learning, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations for in silico identification of GSK3β inhibitors for Alzheimer’s disease
task: Identify GSK3β inhibitors for Alzheimer's disease via ML and molecular dynamics
key_results: Two-stage ML model achieved 0.86 balanced accuracy vs. 0.74 for multiclass; molecular docking and MD simulations identified compounds with multi-target kinase binding profiles
comments: Polypharmacological profile may enhance efficacy but raises off-target liability concerns; experimental kinome validation not reported.

outputs: GSK3β inhibitor predictions (0.86 balanced accuracy, 0.86 specificity)

inputs: predicted GSK3β inhibitors, GSK3α and CDK2 proteins
outputs: binding affinity, interaction profiles, per-residue decomposition

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-target directed ligands targeting GSK3β and related kinases provide superior Alzheimer's therapeutics vs. single-target inhibitors
hypotheses.result: Supported; top hits showed CMGC family multi-target binding profiles consistent with mitigating multiple Tau hyperphosphorylation pathways

title: OncoGen.AI: an integrated platform for automated genomic analysis and reporting in precision oncology
task: Automate genomic analysis and clinical reporting for precision oncology
key_results: 100% recovery of pathogenic mutations vs. proprietary software (DRAGEN, Torrent Suite) on 13 clinical exomes; superior sensitivity on Ion Torrent data

task: Enable differentiable spiking neurons for scientific ML via QIF model
key_results: QIF neurons achieve smoother, more accurate PDE solutions than LIF across MLPs, DeepONets, and PINNs; QIF enables gradient-based training with stable optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Smooth differentiable dynamics of QIF enable superior gradient-based training and stable optimization vs. discontinuous LIF

title: Phase-only synthesis of cosecant-squared patterns with reduced sidelobes in large planar arrays via physics-informed deep neural networks
task: Phase-only antenna pattern synthesis via physics-informed deep learning
key_results: PIDNN achieves superior pattern fidelity and sidelobe suppression vs. GA/PSO; faster convergence on large planar arrays
comments: Physics-informed loss functions elegantly encode domain constraints, but comparison limited to classical optimization rather than other DL methods.

title: Oxide-informed explainable machine learning with uncertainty quantification for compressive strength prediction of SCM-blended pervious concrete
task: Explainable ML for compressive strength prediction in SCM-blended pervious concrete
key_results: CatBoost achieves R²=0.9272, RMSE=2.334 MPa on independent test; SHAP identifies curing duration, Al₂O₃, water content as primary drivers; epistemic uncertainty dominates at 62.1%
comments: Comprehensive uncertainty quantification and explainability via SHAP is rigorous; oxide-level chemical descriptors are interpretable and domain-grounded.

inputs: 659 samples: CaO, SiO₂, Al₂O₃, Fe₂O₃, MgO, alkali, aggregate, water, curing duration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Oxide-level chemical descriptors and ensemble ML enable accurate, explainable strength prediction with uncertainty quantification
hypotheses.result: CatBoost R²=0.9272; SHAP reveals Al₂O₃ pozzolanic role; Monte Carlo shows 62.1% epistemic uncertainty

key_results: Random Forest regression achieves best performance (unspecified R² values given) for predicting bandwidth and resonant frequency; validated against CST simulation and physical measurements

task: Real-time anomaly detection in solar PV systems via edge computing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Edge inference maintains accuracy under shading, dust, and inverter disturbances

title: A lightweight heuristic for cost-efficient IaaS auto-scaling of small-scale web applications
task: Cost-efficient auto-scaling for small-scale IaaS web applications
key_results: LASH reduces cost 41.9% vs fixed-threshold, 13.5% vs AWS Target Tracking; 75.9% SLA-violation reduction; all gains statistically significant (p<0.001, ε²=0.97)

title: Broadband Radiative Heat Transfer Suppression via Dispersion-Engineered Metasurfaces
task: Broadband radiative heat transfer suppression via dispersion-engineered dielectric metasurface pairs
key_results: 82% reduction in radiative heat exchange vs. fused silica (angle-resolved emissivity); 62.5% reduction in direct radiometric power; 7-layered metasurface pair; robust across 320–500 K and fabrication tolerances
comments: Complementary dispersion engineering through SGD optimization circumvents Bode-Fano limits and enables all-dielectric broadband thermal decoupling beyond conventional DBR approaches.

model_io.model: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) optimization for aperiodic DBR pair co-design

hypotheses.hypothesis: Misaligned DBR passbands enable broadband thermal decoupling beyond Bode-Fano limit

title: Synergistic DFT and temperature-dependent Raman profiling of fluorinated mesogens

hypotheses.hypothesis: Raman peak behavior correlates with structural phase transitions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metasurface reduces mutual coupling and enhances gain

title: Design and analysis of modified octagonal ring-shaped MIMO antenna with connected ground for 5G sub-6 GHz n79, Wi-Fi 5, and Wi-Fi 6E band applications

comments: Connected-ground structure with multiple strips/slits effectively reduces mutual coupling while maintaining compact 60×60 mm² form factor and excellent diversity metrics.

model_io.model: Four-port modified octagonal ring MIMO antenna on FR4

hypotheses.hypothesis: Connected-ground topology improves impedance matching and reduces mutual coupling

title: Intricacies of frustrated magnetism in the Kondo metal YbAgGe
task: Understanding frustrated magnetism and Kondo screening interplay in YbAgGe
key_results: Dynamic magnetic correlations below T* ≈ 20 K; antiferromagnetic long-range order at TN = 0.68 K with reduced modulated moment
comments: Study reveals that local moment Hamiltonians alone are insufficient for frustrated Kondo metals, requiring incorporation of itinerant electron effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frustration and Kondo screening independently determine ground state properties
hypotheses.result: Disproven; coupled itinerant-localized electron effects dominate

hypotheses.hypothesis: RKKY or Kondo suppression mechanisms explain magnetism
hypotheses.result: Insufficient; more sophisticated Hamiltonians needed
